sees: frame 1: A faint classroom background (board, desks, clock) behind a pale card. Two icons side by side: a gray theater mask labeled MASK and a gray-and-black shield with a cross labeled SAFETY. Both look dimmed/neutral.
frame 2: The mask has turned bright yellow with a yellow ring around it. A curved arrow arcs from the mask to the shield. A white zigzag crack/lightning line has appeared across the shield.
frame 3: Same as frame 2: yellow highlighted mask, arrow to the shield, crack across the shield. The picture is held.
changed: The mask lit up yellow and got a ring; an arrow was drawn from the mask to the shield; the shield gained a crack/zigzag break line.
cause: The mask (a put-on face or pretense) acts on the shield (safety), shown by the arrow.
effect: Safety is broken or damaged by the mask, which is to say the pretense undermines or fails to provide real safety.
message: The narrator is saying that wearing a mask (hiding your real self) in a classroom setting breaks or undermines the sense of safety it was meant to give.
wouldConfuse: The crack could be read as the shield being broken, as lightning, or as a slash. It is unclear whether the mask protects the shield or breaks it. The yellow highlight could suggest the mask is the good element. The classroom setting is faint and its role is unclear.
